question: Does the least-bad discovery network kernel transfer unchanged to RXJ1347, and is its effect better or worse than the no-route and averaged local-vector references?

candidate.selection_rule: lowest five-cluster equal-system RMS among explicit network variants, transferred regardless of whether it beat eta=0

evaluation.label: RXJ1347
evaluation.baseline_geometry: Fit the P0554 eta=0 radial law to all six images using six ordinary geometry nuisances, then hold that geometry fixed for every route formula.
evaluation.pair_split: Within each two-image family, use the lexicographically first image to infer the source and the second as the formula holdout.
evaluation.qualification: The geometry has seen all six images, so this is an untouched-formula/fixed-geometry transfer, not a fully blind image prediction.
evaluation.transfer_gate: Candidate must converge all three heldout roots and have lower exact heldout RMS than both references; failure is retained as a sensitivity result, not tuned.

claim_limits: RXJ1347 has only three two-image families, so its baseline geometry cannot be fitted on an independent within-family training subset.
The eta=0 ordinary geometry is fitted using all six images before route formulas are compared; only the route formula is held out.
The Tian spherical baryonic profile and member-light catalog omit full gas/ICL covariance.
The fixed route candidate failed its discovery improvement gate and is transferred to measure failure generalization, not to seek confirmation.
No result from this one cluster promotes a gravity formula.
